versions.content: 210 of 501  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Name Dem_DTCSeverityType Kind Bitfield Derived from uint8 Kind Name Mask Description bit DEM_SEVERITY_NO_ SEVERITY 0x00 No severity information available bit DEM_SEVERITY_WWHOBD_ CLASS_NO_CLASS 0x01 No class information bit DEM_SEVERITY_WWHOBD_ CLASS_A 0x02 WWH-OBD Class A bit DEM_SEVERITY_WWHOBD_ CLASS_B1 0x04 WWH-OBD Class B1 bit DEM_SEVERITY_WWHOBD_ CLASS_B2 0x08 WWH-OBD Class B2 bit DEM_SEVERITY_WWHOBD_ CLASS_C 0x10 WWH-OBD Class C bit DEM_SEVERITY_ MAINTENANCE_ONLY 0x20 maintenance required bit DEM_SEVERITY_CHECK_AT_ NEXT_HALT 0x40 check at next halt Elements bit DEM_SEVERITY_CHECK_ IMMEDIATELY 0x80 Check immediately Description Type definition of DTCSeverityMask / DTCSeverity byte containing the DTC severity and DTC class information according to ISO 14229-1 Annex D.3. The upper 3 bits (bit 7-5) are used to represent the DTC severity information. The lower 5 bits (bit 4-0) are used to represent the DTC class information. Available via Dem.h
